messages.author: 236757ea0d25d872
messages.subject: simulateData with
parts:
Dear lavaan experts, 
I am doing a simple simulation and I want to replicate it (monte carlo). 
In Mplus we can specify the replication by NREPS = 500 (for instance), therefore in the end I will have the averages of the estimated parameters, the standard errors, etc. 

How can I do it in R? 

My codes is below. 

####
require(lavaan)

set.seed (12345)

# SIMULATION FOR TWO FACTOR, EACH WITH THREE INDICATORS

pop_model <-'

F1 =~ 1*X1+0.75*X2+0.64*X3
F1 ~~ 0.24*F1
F1 ~~ 0.03*F2

F2 =~ 1*X4+1.4*X5+1.3*X6
X1 ~~0.35*X1
X2 ~~0.35*X2
X3 ~~0.35*X3
X4 ~~0.35*X4
X5 ~~0.35*X5
X6 ~~0.35*X6
'

sample<-simulateData(model=pop_model, sample.nobs = 5000, model.type="sem")

####

test.model <- '
F1 =~ X1+X2+X3
F2 =~ X4+X5+X6
'

fit <- sem(test.model, data=sample, estimator="MLR")

summary(fit, standardized=TRUE)

Best, 
E

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: simulateData with
parts:
simulateData will only generate one data set at a time (there is no argument for reps). If you want to run a Monte Carlo simulation, I'd recommend taking a look at the simsem package (which can take lavaan syntax as generating and analysis models).

Alex
